name: polymarket-copy-trader
description: Polls Polymarket activity API for a target user's BUY trades and mirrors them as market orders

scripts.reset: node -e "['trades-log.json','seen-trades.json','status.json'].forEach(f=>{try{require('fs').unlinkSync(f)}catch{}}); console.log('state reset — restart the trader to re-baseline')"
scripts.restart: yarn down && yarn reset && yarn up
